method: Manual source/assertion and public acceptance-receipt review. Status is an inferred scope assessment; source/test mentions never establish behavior completion. Tests were inspected, not rerun by this catalogue-only change. All partial rows require the stated missing acceptance; missing means no supported behavior in scope, not merely absent evidence. Unlisted natives are unaudited.

natives.scope: Function request and installed multitask lifetime, including cancellation and rebinding
natives.limits: Verified: installed BAT native/browser pending-token continuation is accepted under #9. Unknown: all group initialization/default/model-replacement branches and rendered cue ordering under #11. A closed encoding scope does not complete the whole native.

natives.scope: Receiver-owned animation request, wait, routed identity and cancellation
natives.limits: Verified by source inspection: synthetic public-stage tests exercise requests, receiver identity and token cleanup. Unknown: matched installed original/native/browser request and replacement sequences. #11 draw/sheath observations are related playback evidence, not acceptance of every PushAnimation branch.

natives.scope: Animation task with held receiver turn while the requested group plays
natives.limits: Verified by source inspection: task-manager call/poll test checks turn and group lifetime. It is below the public ScriptWorld caller. Unknown: installed routed dispatch, replacement and original/native/browser turn/render parity.

natives.scope: Task-frame wait uses receiver playback without advancing it
natives.limits: Verified by source inspection: public calls distinguish receiver/selected playback and unavailable owner errors. Unknown: installed original/native/browser frame-boundary and cue-order comparison. The #11 browser chain does not isolate this native.

natives.scope: Create named script object at rotated creator offset with explicit orientation
natives.limits: Verified by source inspection: public script test creates BALL and rejects unknown script names. #7 contact-body oracle/tests cover a different stage. Unknown: installed projectile creation/impact, generation lifetime and recycling parity across original/native/browser.

natives.scope: Create named script object aimed at selected player
natives.limits: Verified by source inspection: public script test checks created pose against selected target. Unknown: matched installed aim, dynamic actor lifetime, impact and recycling across original/native/browser. Source arithmetic is not live acceptance.

natives.scope: Retained flight task, parent-range completion, wall/contact body selection
natives.limits: Verified: public ordinary-update tests check 15 flight steps, continuation and wall stop; #7 records selected-body original oracle and negative control. Unknown: live installed impact/recycling parity, authored actor order and rendered/audio response. Contact fidelity also belongs to #28.

natives.scope: Smoke/fireball update, target-range/cooldown and death item swap
natives.limits: Verified by source inspection: public tests cover no-target, below-range and dead-receiver swap. Unknown: actual installed smoke/fireball/cooldown sequence and original/native/browser presentation. No live dragon acceptance was found in reviewed #7 receipts.

natives.scope: Multitask invokes shared breath update until dead receiver completes it
natives.limits: Verified by source inspection: helper test calls Task::complete with a recording host, checks repeat/zero and missing-owner failure. It does not dispatch a public script call. Unknown: installed multitask encoding, snapshot rebinding and live original/native/browser continuation.

natives.scope: Selected drawn-weapon swing admission and retained tip sphere query
natives.caller: ScriptWorld::advance -> crates/cyrus-game/src/script/registry.rs -> actor_weapon_predicates / retained weapon endpoints
natives.limits: Verified by source inspection: the named public test checks only the no-drawn-weapon/no-swing false branch. #28 range_contact tests exercise a different contact caller, so they do not prove this native positive path. Unknown: positive/edge contact dispatch and original/native/browser comparison.

natives.scope: Selected/generic additive health modes, admission, feedback and failure ordering
natives.limits: Verified: published public-routing regression/original wrapper oracle covers selected addition and retained feedback. The native quick-health observation is related shared health behavior, not direct AdjustHealth acceptance. Unknown: all death modes/environmental effects, rendered/audio browser and restart parity.

natives.scope: Absolute health write with generic admission and death-service ownership
natives.limits: Verified by source inspection: public script cases cover absolute value, attribute120 inhibition and missing death/weapon owners. Those contextual missing-input errors are deliberate service guards, not proof the entire behavior is missing. Unknown: direct installed original/native/browser absolute health and fatal-mode continuation.

natives.scope: Receiver attribute3 query and its ownership through the public script caller
natives.limits: Verified by source inspection: public test returns receiver values0,40,100. The quick-health live receipt measures state, not this exact query call. Unknown: a retained installed original/native/browser query observation and all receiver-form coverage. No full-native completion inferred from a simple dispatch arm.

natives.scope: Receiver dead-state predicate through public native routing
natives.limits: Verified by source inspection: first test actually dispatches isDead for a living receiver and checks zero; second only calls mark_actor_dead and checks attribute3, despite its name. Unknown: positive dead predicate through public dispatch and matched installed original/native/browser observation. Death presentation remains #32. The native armed/unarmed death receipt observes groups121/122, not a positive isDead script result.

natives.scope: Synchronous idempotent combat entry and selected/nonselected retained owners
natives.limits: Verified: public tests cover statement/expression/derived inputs and repeated entry; #25 accepts automatic START message continuation. #26 comparison corrects an earlier unmatched-frame-rate cadence claim. Unknown: all routed/reset/contact boundary branches and full pacing parity; #25 closure does not complete this broader combat scope.
